title: Secret Shack
body:
Description

The Secret Shack can be accessed by climbing one of the spikes located in Acid Wastes biome.

Touching it results in obtaining the "⬟ A Familiar Place" badge.

Appearance

Secret Shack is a small booth with a shelf, a kicked down door, a rusted golden axe, and a shriveled up potted cacti housed inside. Before the map revamp, it also contained a rubber duckie nearby. It was once located on the Familiar Island, but after the map revamp, it got impaled atop one of the spikes in the Acid Wastes.

Trivia

  • This shack is a reference to the previous Typical Developers project called Woodmill Inc.
